quest.title: Wangshu Take-Away
quest.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got something else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I really can't spare the time right now...

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Agh, I don't think I can get back in time.

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Oh, you actually brought it all the way here. Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: So it's like this: that air-headed Ling'guan ordered some Come And Get It, saying that she'd come back and eat it later. But my money's on her having wandered off somewhere and gotten lost.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Go deliver this to her. <color=#00E1FFFF>Steady now, and don't run around however you like</color>, or it'll spill.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Try to avoid touching elemental stuff as well, or the taste might get all mixed up</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If it goes bad, come back here and I'll whip up another serving for you.

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Hehe... Looks like I've lost my way again.
